policy: Correct only the 20 confirmed source mappings. Keep broad native heritage traits; use Filipino for the three Luzon identities and a closed Mulam–Maonan composite. Never rename an entire old POP group when it contains unaffected sources. Preserve the current calibrated population separately from the immutable original population. Historical homeland additions are bounded state projections; retain all prior claims and do not infer new claims from population share.
budget_reason: The prior 600 ceiling predates the confirmed identity defects. A bounded increase to 605 permits their correction without merging unrelated identities merely to hit a round number. All 16 new assets share existing heritage traits; the effective-definition ceiling stays 665.

eu5_resident_oirat_culture.homeland_basis: Dzungarian Oirat core only; no automatic Volga or whole-Mongolia claim.

eu5_resident_frisian.homeland_basis: Friesland historical core; broader East/North Frisian claims deferred, not the whole Netherlands or Hannover.

eu5_resident_romansh.homeland_basis: Graubunden core projected to the eastern Swiss state, not all Switzerland. Italic is a broad gameplay heritage reuse, not Italian ethnic identity.

eu5_resident_sasak_culture.homeland_basis: Lombok core represented by the coarse Sunda Islands state; does not claim every island ethnographically.

eu5_resident_madurese_culture.homeland_basis: Madura Island projected to East Java; secondary diaspora on Sabu does not create a homeland.

eu5_resident_lisu_culture.homeland_basis: Yunnan historical core, including pre-1780 regional presence; later migration is not backdated to all neighboring states. Yi heritage remains the approved broad grouping, not Yi ethnicity.

eu5_resident_hani_culture.homeland_basis: Long-established Honghe/Ailao core projected to Yunnan, not inferred from a current majority.

eu5_resident_lahu_culture.homeland_basis: Yunnan core documented in early-18th-century local history; no automatic Thai or Burmese diaspora claim.

eu5_resident_jino_culture.homeland_basis: Jinuo/Youle hills in Sipsongpanna, documented before 1780; source emigrants do not create extra claims.

eu5_resident_mulam_maonan.homeland_basis: Closed two-member gameplay composite around Luocheng/Huanjiang; neither all Zhuang nor all Kam-Sui. Guizhou extension withheld pending finer historical projection.

eu5_resident_limbu_culture.homeland_basis: Historical Limbuwan core in eastern Nepal projected by Taplejung; not every place with Limbu POPs and not all Tibet.

eu5_resident_gurage.homeland_basis: Historical core southwest of Shewa requires a more precise target-state projection. Jibat presence alone is insufficient. Explicitly deferred; no blanket inheritance of Amhara homelands.

eu5_resident_tigre.homeland_basis: Eritrean lowland core only; relatedness to Tigrinya does not imply Tigray homeland inheritance.

eu5_resident_norn_culture.homeland_basis: Orkney/Shetland represented by the coarse Highlands state. Does not mean mainland Highlands were Norn-speaking; surviving source identity is retained.

eu5_resident_tsoyaha_culture.homeland_basis: Historical Tennessee core retained by this alternate-history save; real-world forced movement is not automatically imposed. Southeastern heritage is reused; Yuchi language remains an isolate.

eu5_resident_lucayo.homeland_basis: Lucayan Bahamas core; no automatic claim on all Caribbean islands and no merger of unresolved Ciboney.

asset_limitations: The identity and language distinctions have evidence, but template name pools, graphics, appearance and default religion remain provisional. Actual resident religions are preserved exactly. Shared heritage assignments are explicit broad gameplay designs, not ethnic equivalence. Current world/literacy totals are verified separately from the uncalibrated source ledger.
